name: Texas Auto Dealership License Database 2026 — 21,003 Records (CSV)
summary: 21,003 licensed auto dealerships in Texas — sourced directly from the TxDMV LACE Salesforce portal. Includes franchised dealers (Chevrolet, Toyota, Ford, etc.), independent used-car dealers, salvage dealers, manufacturers, and distributors. Updated daily by TxDMV. $49 one-time vs. $200-$500+ subscription pricing from commercial brokers.
audience: CRM/DMS software vendors (CDK Global, DealerSocket, VinSolutions, Tekion, AutoRaptor) running outbound sales campaigns; automotive parts and equipment distributors targeting dealership service departments; F&I product providers (warranty companies, GAP insurance); digital marketing agencies specializing in dealership SEO/SEM; auto auction companies (Manheim, ADESA); automotive lenders and floor plan financing companies; franchise development teams.
source: Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV) LACE Salesforce Portal — texasdmv.my.salesforce-sites.com/dealers — public bulk download, no auth required, updated daily
competitive_wedge: $49 flat-price CSV vs. $200-$500+ subscriptions from LeadsPlease, BookYourData, BlueMailMedia. No recurring fees, no per-contact pricing. Direct from state DMV licensing data.
